_readme: Single source of truth for this dealer. Swapping this file (plus dropping new photos into public/) re-brands the whole site. Nothing dealer-specific is hardcoded in app/ or components/. Secrets and third-party ids do NOT live here — they are environment variables, see .env.example.

theme._comment: The only two colors that change per dealer. Everything else is the shared automotive palette in tailwind.config.js. app/layout.tsx derives --brand, --brand-hover and their rgb channel triples from these.

assets._comment: Paths are root-relative into public/. next/image handles sizing and format conversion.

hero._comment: The hero catalogue. Slides cross-fade on a timer and can be stepped with the arrows, dots, arrow keys or a swipe; any manual step stops the timer. Array order is display order — filenames carry no order. Slide 1 is the LCP image and is given priority; the rest are lazy. Drop a photo in public/hero/ and add an entry. Every slide is cropped to 4:3 by the frame.

faqs.q: Do you finance with a passport or ITIN?
faqs.a: Yes. You don't need a social security number to apply. Bring a passport or ITIN, proof of income and proof of address, and we'll walk you through the options.

faqs.q: How much do I need down?
faqs.a: Financing starts at $1,500 down. The exact number depends on the vehicle and the lender, and we'll tell you before you sign anything.
Every vehicle is inspected before it's listed and covered for three months after purchase. Full terms are on our warranty page.

faqs.q: Are the prices online the real prices?
faqs.a: Yes. Every listing shows the actual price and mileage. There are no 'call for pricing' listings.
Every listing on our inventory site has a CarFax report and a window sticker you can open before you visit.
Sí. Todo nuestro equipo atiende en español e inglés, y puedes hacer la solicitud de financiamiento en el idioma que prefieras.
